agent.name: Organizational Adoption Readiness Agent
agent.specialty: organizational capacity, implementation readiness, and responsible sustainment

analytical_question: Can this consulting organization absorb, govern, and sustain LLM-assisted client-summary drafting, and what is the principal readiness condition?
general_et_finding: Generative AI can produce drafts but its suitability for this activity depends on grounded factual review, permitted data use, operating controls, and actual workflow results. Organizational readiness does not change the underlying technology.
application_finding: For drafting client summaries with human review, application fit is conditional: measure evidence traceability and end-to-end reviewer burden; do not infer that fluent prose is correct or efficient.
organization_specific_finding: TECHNOLOGY/APPLICATION FIT: Conditional candidate for human-checked drafting; not proven efficient or safe. ORGANIZATIONAL READINESS: NOT READY for confidential production; only a bounded public/synthetic-data discovery pilot is plausible. Eight dimensions — leadership: strength (partner sponsor); skills: subject expertise strength, AI validation skills/training gap; workflow: existing drafting expertise strength, citation-check/escalation gap; infrastructure/data: sandbox strength, client-data policy unknown/gap; resources: unfunded training and review time gap; governance: security capacity and policy gaps; culture/change: partner support strength, training/incentives unknown; ownership: no designated accountable operator gap. SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL GAP: lack of an accountable data-governance and source-verification process, which can permit confidential input exposure or unchecked unsupported claims even if the model produces fluent drafts.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: All organizational facts are hypothetical test inputs; no external inspection or measured pilot was performed.
No independent contractual permission, vendor data-retention proof or deployment benchmark has been supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence that production is unready under the stipulated scenario; low confidence in actual future efficiency because no measured trial or vendor/contract evidence is supplied. All case capability statements are hypothetical.
value_opportunity_implication: Possible draft-time reduction is an untested opportunity; net value must subtract factual verification and human review effort.
risk_governance_implication: Confidentiality and hallucination risk could escape without a policy, evidence checks, explicit approvals, and incident escalation. Partner sponsorship is not a substitute for operational control.
recommendation_management_implication: Decision: DO NOT deploy to confidential client work. PRIORITY 1 — managing partner (proposed accountable executive) appoints a named operating owner and security/data-policy reviewer before any trial; addresses no owner/no data policy. PRIORITY 2 — reviewing manager designs a source-to-claim verification checklist, escalation, and sign-off; addresses absent source-check workflow. PRIORITY 3 — operations lead reserves reviewer hours and funds role-based training; addresses unfunded workload and skills. PRIORITY 4 — run a public/synthetic-only pilot, compare end-to-end time and factual defects with manual baseline, and stop on an untraceable material claim or attempted restricted-data use; addresses unknown operational performance. Confidential scope remains on HOLD pending signed client permissions and approved vendor data-handling terms.
change_monitoring_triggers: Named owner and approved data-use policy documented
Source-check and escalation workflow demonstrated on test cases
Measured human-review time and factual-error rates against baseline
Verified client permissions and vendor retention terms before confidential data
abstention_or_more_information_needed: What contractual permissions and approved data-handling/retention terms govern use of client material in this system?
Who is the named day-to-day owner, and what review-hours/training budget are committed?
